classification_rules: Keep allegation, charge, plea, conviction, and sentence distinct.
Do not infer identity from video imagery alone.
Record source spelling conflicts as aliases.

findings.finding: Driver identified as Charmayne Huerta Guzman.
Crash occurred Jan. 14, 2024 in Kearns, Utah.
Measured BAC reported as 0.241% and speed estimated at 77 mph in a 35 mph zone.
Lennyn Lilic died after the crash.
Guzman pleaded guilty and received consecutive prison terms.

data.method: YouTube metadata and transcript extraction followed by cross-source verification against KSL arrest, charging, plea, and sentencing reports.
